g.text: Setbacks shown are design assumptions, not verified byelaws.
Road width, property line and levels need a survey.
No surveyed drainage fall or flood datum supplied.
Default steps are not a step-free route.
Dimensions govern; do not scale from a screen.
PRELIMINARY - ENGINEER TO REVIEW - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
Reference design screen only. Survey, structure, services, byelaws and professional approval remain outstanding.
